FormHug is the strongest Fillout alternative for teams that want more free submission volume, stronger AI-native workflows, quiz and assessment tools, or Public Query. If you're pushing against Fillout's limits — or discovering that Fillout's AI and quiz features aren't deep enough — FormHug is built for exactly that gap. [...] Fillout has best-in-class conditional logic that handles very complex branching scenarios exceptionally well. It also has native Notion integration, which makes it a strong fit for Notion-centric teams. If your workflows depend heavily on Notion or require the most sophisticated conditional logic available in a form builder, Fillout is worth evaluating.

There is no direct one-click migration. The recommended approach is AI-assisted rebuilding: paste a public Fillout form URL into FormHug, which uses it as a reference to generate a comparable form. Standard fields, conditional logic, and basic layouts transfer well. Custom themes, advanced Notion connections, and complex multi-step flows will need more manual work. [...] FormHug is stronger for quiz and assessment workflows. It includes a full scoring engine, personality-style assessments, radar reports, knowledge exams, and certificate generation. Fillout offers basic quiz features but does not match FormHug's depth in scoring, result outputs, and certification. If assessments are a core use case for your team, FormHug is the better fit.

FormHug was designed around AI from the start — natural language form generation, AI-powered optimization, and agent control via MCP are core features, not add-ons. Fillout added AI generation in 2024 in response to market demand. Both tools let you generate forms with AI, but FormHug's AI coverage is broader and deeper across more form scenarios.
